options.label: E
options.text: I can't tell from this passage

parsed.note: Replaced the unnatural phrase “becomes sin to” with clear wording that asks which action is attributed as the family's sin. Changed “anyone as priests” to “anyone as a priest” to fix the singular–plural mismatch while preserving unrestricted appointment.
